metaDescription: Order custom gray personal protection equipment for your team. Browse high-visibility PPE with your logo at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gray personal protection equipment offers a professional, neutral look that blends into industrial and construction environments without sacrificing safety. Safety managers often choose gray hard hats and vests for workers who need high visibility but prefer a less stark contrast than orange or yellow. These items pair well with reflective striping for added visibility in low-light conditions. Customize with your company logo using screen printing or heat transfer for a cohesive team appearance.
